2rude.bio: Toronto producer and songwriter 2Rude is a veteran figure in Canadian hip-hop, known for production and collaborations across the country's rap scene.

3mfrench.bio: Toronto rapper 3MFrench is part of the city's contemporary street-rap scene, releasing melodic, hard-edged records tied closely to local hip-hop culture.

401 wst.bio: 401 WST is a Toronto electronic and club-music project associated with Canadian producers Bambii and Bonjay's Alanna Stuart, drawing from dancehall, house and global club sounds.

4korners.bio: Toronto DJ and producer 4KORNERS, longtime official DJ for the Toronto Raptors, blends hip-hop, dance and global club music in his sets and productions.

6ix.bio: Maryland-born producer 6ix is best known for his longtime creative partnership with Logic and for production that spans hip-hop and contemporary rap.

6ixbuzz.bio: 6ixBuzz is a Toronto media and music platform that expanded from social-media coverage of the city into releases, compilations and collaborations with Canadian hip-hop artists.

88glam.bio: 88GLAM is a Toronto rap duo formed by Derek Wise and 88 Camino, known for atmospheric trap, melodic hooks and a run of projects rooted in the city's late-2010s hip-hop sound.

a l l i e.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter a l l i e makes intimate alternative R&B and soul shaped by layered vocals, understated production and deeply personal writing.

a tribe called red.bio: Ottawa-founded Indigenous electronic group A Tribe Called Red, now known as The Halluci Nation, fused powwow music with club production, hip-hop and politically charged performance.

a-game.bio: A-Game is a Toronto rap duo made up of twin brothers Nova and Chase, known for melodic street rap and early-2010s releases from the city's hip-hop scene.

adam bomb.bio: Toronto rapper Adam Bomb is a veteran of Canada's underground hip-hop scene, known for battle-tested lyricism, solo releases and collaborations with artists across the city.

adrian sina.bio: Romanian singer, producer and DJ Adrian Sînă is best known as a founding member of dance-pop group Akcent and for a long-running solo career in European pop and club music.

adriatique.bio: Adriatique is a Swiss electronic-music duo from Zürich whose deep, melodic house and techno has made them a prominent international touring and festival act.

afrojack.bio: Dutch DJ and producer AFROJACK is an internationally successful electronic artist known for festival-scale house records, pop collaborations and chart-crossing dance production.

aftertheparty.bio: Aftertheparty is an independent singer, songwriter and producer known for hazy alternative R&B, understated vocals and self-produced releases built largely outside the traditional label system.

aiza.bio: Montréal-raised, Toronto-based artist Aiza makes genre-blending pop and R&B shaped by her Burundian heritage, theatrical performance background and upbeat songwriting.

alejandro fernández.bio: Mexican singer Alejandro Fernández is one of the best-known contemporary voices in ranchera and Latin pop, carrying forward a multigenerational family legacy in Mexican music.

ali gatie.bio: Iraqi-Canadian singer-songwriter Ali Gatie, raised in the Toronto area, built an international audience with emotionally direct pop and R&B centred on heartbreak and vulnerability.

alice ivy.bio: Melbourne producer and multi-instrumentalist Alice Ivy creates sample-rich electronic pop that blends soul, hip-hop and indie influences with a strong collaborative streak.

alicia creti.bio: Montréal-born singer-songwriter Alicia Creti makes emotionally direct contemporary R&B and pop built around piano-led songwriting and a powerful, soulful vocal style.

alicia moffet.bio: Québec singer-songwriter Alicia Moffet is a pop artist and television personality whose bilingual catalogue moves between polished pop, R&B and contemporary singer-songwriter styles.

aliocha schneider.bio: Paris-born, Montréal-raised singer-songwriter and actor Aliocha Schneider makes intimate folk-pop and indie music in both French and English.

allan rayman.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Allan Rayman makes shadowy alternative R&B and rock-inflected pop, pairing a gravelly vocal style with deliberately mysterious visual and narrative world-building.

aluna.bio: British singer, songwriter and producer Aluna Francis, formerly one half of AlunaGeorge, makes club-forward electronic pop shaped by house, dancehall and global dance music.

alunageorge.bio: AlunaGeorge is a London electronic duo formed by vocalist Aluna Francis and producer George Reid, known for sleek R&B-influenced pop and UK electronic production.

alvvays.bio: Toronto-based indie-pop band Alvvays is known for jangly guitars, precise melodic songwriting and Molly Rankin's clear, understated vocal delivery.

alysha brilla.bio: Ontario singer-songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist Alysha Brilla blends soul, pop and global influences with independent production and socially conscious songwriting.

alyssa reid.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter Alyssa Reid broke through with the pop hit Alone Again and has continued releasing melodic pop and singer-songwriter material under her own name.

amaarae.bio: Ghanaian-American singer, songwriter and producer Amaarae makes adventurous pop that blends R&B, Afropop, hip-hop and electronic influences with a distinctive high-register vocal style.

anami vice.bio: Vancouver rapper Anami Vice is a Canadian hip-hop artist known for melodic, pop-aware rap and independent releases tied to the West Coast scene.

anaïs cardot.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter Anaïs Cardot makes intimate French-language soul and R&B centred on warm vocals, understated arrangements and emotionally direct writing.

anders.bio: Toronto singer and songwriter anders is a contemporary R&B artist known for atmospheric production, melodic delivery and songs rooted in the city's late-night R&B sound.

anderson .paak.bio: California singer, rapper, drummer and producer Anderson .Paak blends hip-hop, soul, funk and R&B, both as a solo artist and as one half of Silk Sonic.

andrea bocelli.bio: Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli is an internationally renowned classical-crossover singer whose career spans opera, pop standards and large-scale collaborations.

anjulie.bio: Oakville-born Canadian singer-songwriter Anjulie makes pop and R&B while also writing for other artists across mainstream pop and dance music.
